supportRequest.subject: Expose Google-selected and user-declared canonical fields in URL Inspection (lecturesift.com)
supportRequest.html:
Hello GSC Wizard support,

We need Google's selected canonical for sc-domain:lecturesift.com, but the ChatGPT/MCP URL Inspection response does not expose googleCanonical or userCanonical.

Reproduced on 8 October 2026 with inspect_url:

  • inspectionUrl=https://lecturesift.com/: PASS, Submitted and indexed, last crawl 2026-10-01T18:09:40Z. Neither canonical field appears in the text response or structured result.
  • inspectionUrl=https://lecturesift.com/quiz-flashcards: NEUTRAL, Alternate page with proper canonical tag, last crawl 2026-08-29T21:42:44Z. Neither canonical field appears.

The current tool schema accepts only siteUrl and inspectionUrl, and its output schema omits both fields. Your server reference says REST and MCP use the same tool pipeline, so we have not assumed REST exposes additional data.

Google's response schema defines inspectionResult.indexStatusResult.googleCanonical and inspectionResult.indexStatusResult.userCanonical. Please expose these upstream values, when present, in the tool response and output schema, and preserve them in inspection history/tracker exports. Exposing inspectionResult.inspectionResultLink would also help.

Please distinguish a field genuinely omitted by Google from one not exposed by GSC Wizard. We understand Google may omit googleCanonical for a non-indexed page; the requested value must not be inferred from the site's current HTML.

Could you enable the fields or provide the authorized upstream canonical results for the homepage control and these three affected URLs?

  • https://lecturesift.com/quiz-flashcards
  • https://lecturesift.com/pt/quiz-flashcards
  • https://lecturesift.com/pt/contact

Thank you.
